summary.caption: High-taste, fully colored 2D digital painting comic with selective focus: finely rendered layers contrasted against expressive painterly brushwork. Muted warm peach skin and deep navy palette under soft bright stage light, zero rough sketch lines.

items.label: object
items.caption: A wide panel of a brightly lit talk-show set: a warm cream and crimson stage seen from the audience side, empty of people.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean horizontal narration text in a plain white rectangular box.

items.label: object
items.caption: A medium panel of the audience seen from the stage: rows of tired commuters in grey and navy office clothes, lit by a warm stage wash.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean horizontal narration text in a plain white rectangular box.
items.text:
관객석이 갑자기 가득 찼다.
모두 퇴근 복장이었다.

items.label: character
items.caption: A medium panel on the young woman at the edge of the glow: she is a woman in her mid-twenties with a soft oval face, calm dark eyes, and sleek dark hair pulled into a low ponytail. She stands turned three quarters toward the audience, one hand half raised in surprise.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean horizontal dialogue text in a rounded speech balloon, the tail pointing left.

items.label: object
items.caption: A tall panel of the TV-headed host at the centre of the stage: an ageless showman with a boxy old CRT television for a head, a glowing screen face, and an immaculate ebony tuxedo with a deep crimson bow tie. He spreads both arms wide toward the room.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean horizontal dialogue text in a rounded speech balloon, the tail pointing right.
